summary: Restored the established ContinuityField containment and presentation rules removed during stylesheet consolidation, and added a browser regression covering bounded desktop/mobile geometry, overflow, public navigation, and workspace entry.

commands: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- --grep "continuity field stays bounded"
python3 scripts/agentctl.py scope check RECOVER-001 frontend
tests.notes: Vitest passed 9 tests in 4 files; the Vite production build completed; the focused browser regression passed at 1920x1080 and 390x844; the full Playwright suite passed 8 tests; frontend scope check passed for all 3 changed files. Browser-rendered desktop and full mobile screenshots were visually inspected: the canvas, fallback, halo, and four labels remain inside a bounded hero surface with no horizontal overflow, and the established public presentation is restored.

notes_for_next_agent: The repair intentionally restores only the historical ContinuityField-owned containment, canvas/fallback, halo, path, and label rules from approved commit cab3146, with current literal design-system colors because the consolidated stylesheet no longer defines the historical custom properties.
No backend behavior, contract, architecture, runtime canvas behavior, copy, routes, or deployment manifests changed.

The geometry regression explicitly caps the field below 700px, which fails the deployed recursive canvas-resize symptom (~31,102px desktop/~21,330px mobile), and verifies absolute containment for both render surfaces and every label.
